methodology.equivalence: Manual semantic families plus documented prior companion/vision costs. Outcome, agency, information, ethics and world effects considered; equality alone insufficient.
methodology.conservativePolicy: Ambiguous pairs stay in separate groups. Family comparison is not a merge. Prior consequences prevent careless fusion of identical closures. All memberships are proposed, not runtime rules.
methodology.unknown: Silence means unknown, not survival, death, full data, cure or a successful escape.
methodology.confidence: alto: explicit result; medio: elision, paraphrase or insufficient scope; bajo: contradiction or unresolved result. This is not probability.
methodology.stableIdentity: SemanticId assigned editorially and fixed after approval; never regenerate from title, node ID, file order, hash or future classifier. Namespace is storyId.
